request.query: SELECT ticker,security_id,canonical_symbol,share_class_figi,cik,name,asset_type,from_date,LEAST(COALESCE(to_date,DATE '2020-12-31'),DATE '2020-12-31') AS to_date FROM lake.security_segments WHERE from_date<=DATE '2020-12-31' AND (ticker IN ('VPG','VSHw','VSH') OR security_id LIKE 'ticker:VSHw@2010-06-24%') ORDER BY ticker,from_date,security_id
